description: The package provides input data, optimisation code and aggregate results for an uncertainty study of electricity storage and hydrogen infrastructure. It contains an AdOpT-NET0 version, preprocessing utilities and multiple scenario-summary tables. The provider is Wiegner, Jan F.; Gibescu, Madeleine; Gazzani, Matteo. Coverage: The description enumerates 2,000 main scenarios and 500 extreme hydrogen-storage scenarios. Geography, time step and model years are not established from this record. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. Access is marked open. Limitations: This is a paper-specific package containing a named dependency. It should not be conflated with the general AdOpT-NET0 software. For simulation it supports reproducing cost-optimisation scenarios and exploring parameter sensitivity. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
